Bombay High Court orders compensation for sweets shop

The Bombay High Court has ordered the Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to pay Rs 5 lakh in compensation to a sweets shop in Pune. The court's directive stems from the prolonged suspension of the shop's license. The Maharashtra FDA was fined by the court for this action.
